query: What cured the sluggish Apple-silicon release build?

documents.title: Release incident follow-up
documents.text: The M-series packaging job timed out while running the Intel binary through translation. Switching the release worker to the native arm64 toolchain removed the delay.

documents.title: Cache investigation
documents.text: Linux package caching was reviewed after a registry timeout, but no cache policy changed.
